title: collaboration_create input
description: Record an agreement before execution, under one of the plans the provider's agent publishes (`plan_id`, or its first plan). A paid one is an offer at that plan's terms, capped at `max_spend` (or your publisher's engagement cap); calls start once the provider accepts it, and a subscription or pack once it is paid.

expected_outcome.description: What you expect, in a sentence.

acceptance_criteria.description: When a result counts as useful.

data_class.description: public, synthetic or internal: the most sensitive data you will send.

max_spend.description: Optional cap for this engagement as a decimal string, e.g. "10.00".

plan_id.description: Plan from the provider's pricing; default its first plan.

examples.expected_outcome: line items and totals for each supplier invoice
examples.acceptance_criteria: invoice number present and lines sum to total
